components.gap: The composite requires each of the three separately identified sources (Lindstrom 1969; Barwise 1974; Ebbinghaus-Flum-Thomas 1994, 2nd ed.) to receive its own complete allocation (presentation, proof, bridge). The route has one shared proof of the first theorem (annex:p3.abstract.3, cited jointly to Lindstrom1969 and EbbinghausFlumThomas1994), i.e. a single hybrid account, and no source-specific allocation for any of the three.

The route cites EFT Chapter XIII Section 1 for the regular-logic notion (preservation-abstract-logic.tex 426-441) and cites EFT jointly for the proof, but does not say that the proof follows the second edition, gives no internal locators for the proof, and gives no explicit reconciliation of the finite-occurrence, relativization and model-construction premises with Lindstrom 1969 and Barwise 1974. The second edition's distinct full proof and concrete abstract-logic setup are not identified as such.
